payout_quote: Truist Small Business Checking Up To $800 Promotion. Open a new Truist Simple Business Checking or Truist Dynamic Business Checking account online, by phone, or in a branch from 07/14/26 through 3/24/2027 and earn up to $800 after you complete the following qualifying activities (the reward amount earned is based on the balance achieved and maintained).
steps: Open a new Truist Simple Business Checking or Dynamic Business Checking account online, by phone, or in a branch between 7/14/2026 and 3/24/2027.
Enroll in the promotion at account opening with a valid single-use promo code (generated on Truist's promotion page; cannot be added after the account is opened).
Deposit at least $2,500 ($400 tier) or $10,000 ($800 tier) into the enrolled account within 30 days of account opening; current balance must be at least that amount on day 30.
Maintain a daily current balance of at least $2,500 / $10,000 from day 30 through day 90. If the balance falls below $10,000 but stays at $2,500+, the $400 tier is still earned.
Reward is deposited into the new checking account within 10 business days after qualification is verified ($800 paid as two $400 deposits).
catches: Promo-code enrollment is mandatory: a valid single-use promo code must be applied at account opening and cannot be added later; codes should not be shared.
Strict balance clock: deposit within 30 days, current balance (ledger balance, excludes holds/pendings) must meet the tier on day 30 and every day from day 30 through day 90.
New business checking clients only: the business cannot have had or closed a Truist business checking account within 365 days prior to 7/14/2026 with the same TIN/EIN.
Business physical address must be in AL, AR, FL, GA, IN, KY, MD, MS, NC, NJ, OH, PA, SC, TN, TX, VA, WV, or DC.

Dynamic Business Checking carries a $25 monthly maintenance fee, waivable only with a $5,000 average combined balance over three months — fee drag if not waived (Simple Business Checking has no monthly fee).
Reward forfeited if at payout the account is closed, restricted, or at $0/negative balance.
Truist may report the reward to the IRS; taxes are the recipient's responsibility. Offer is nontransferable, cannot be combined with other offers, and may be discontinued at any time.
biggest_catch: Every day matters: the balance must hit $2,500 ($400) or $10,000 ($800) on day 30 AND stay there every single day through day 90 — one dip to zero forfeits the payout entirely. Plus, enrollment requires a single-use promo code captured at account opening; it cannot be added later. Offer window closes 3/24/2027.
eligibility: New Truist business checking clients only (no Truist business checking within 365 days with same TIN); business physical address in AL, AR, FL, GA, IN, KY, MD, MS, NC, NJ, OH, PA, SC, TN, TX, VA, WV, or DC; enrollment with a valid single-use promo code at account opening.
timing: Open 7/14/2026-3/24/2027; deposit within 30 days; balance at tier level on day 30; maintain daily through day 90; reward deposited within 10 business days after qualification.
